text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp draws to a close... A summer where, having become a true duo,
we made the conscious choice to focus on "relaxing."

Nervously, I ask how she's doing.
Just how is Super Creek's condition...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I don't really know how to put it into words...
but I feel like... my bones are gone.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes~. It's a fish bone. For as long as I can remember, it's been stuck right in my throat.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It feels like that finally came right off.
So, I feel really good right now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I think it'll probably be okay now.
Besides, even if it doesn't work out...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"And my now-dependable Trainer
is supporting me. Fufu♪"

It looks like it worked.
She might have fully regained her top form.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer-san, shall we head back?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No, back to when we had just debuted.
Back to those days when we didn't have a single worry.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There's still the rest of the Classics left...
Right?

As long as the Kikuka Sho is ahead,
Super Creek's true strength can surely be proven.
